note: User-editable capability registry. Unknown stays unknown. Nothing here is inferred from a model name or price. Providers listed are those the survey found configured; this file selects among them only.

evidence.measured: verified by an evaluation in eval/reports/
evidence.documented: stated by the provider and not verified here
evidence.unknown: we do not know; do not use for work that depends on the capability

evidence.caveat: task-level results only; no capability ranking
listed because the provider may serve it; nothing verified

policy.unknownCapability: excluded from assignment unless the plan explicitly allows untested models
policy.providerSwitch: never automatic; requires a plan that names the provider and a human approval
